svg.title: Dota Router high-level design
svg.desc: A source-backed high-level flow of Dota Router configuration, adapter-specific navigation, and the shared RouterUtils route matching and rendering pipeline.
svg.text: Configuration assembly → adapter-specific navigation → shared route resolution and custom-element rendering
DotaRouterService accepts a ready route tree or component classes carrying @Route metadata.
elements are required to create a RouterService
validates routes, registers listeners, renders current pathname
One adapter is selected by the application; both implementations feed the same rendering pipeline.
not a hash change or download
Both adapters provide a pathname and router context to the same RouterUtils pipeline.
exact → prefix + children → recursive lookup → parent fallback
normalize slash; delegate redirect to adapter
custom rendering owns the DOM effect
Color describes the kind of step; line style describes how control moves.
dashed purple arrow · async Navigation API handler
Source: packages/libs/dota-router/src/DotaRouterService.ts · RouterUtils.ts · dom-history.router.ts · dom-navigation.router.ts · route.decorator.ts · Types.ts
Behavior note: defaultRoute is stored and passed to adapters, while current rendering is driven by window.location.pathname and RouterUtils.findRoute().
Utility note: getCurrentPath() reads window.location.pathname; getPreviousPath() reads the Navigation API entry list; getChildPath() drives recursive child lookup.
